name: Redcap
description: A murderous goblin of Anglo-Scottish Border folklore who haunts ruined peel-towers and castles, dyeing his cap in the blood of travellers he kills.

aliases.name: Dunter
aliases.meaning: from the muffled dunting noise heard in the towers it haunts

aliases.name: Robin Redcap
aliases.meaning: named familiar of William de Soulis

origin: Confined to the Anglo-Scottish Border country, with sympathetic legends in adjacent areas of northern England and southern Scotland.
